title: Canonical Color as a Lens into Concept Decodability in Vision Encoders and VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.09124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual encoders construct a representation of the image input for Vision-Language models. How much conceptual, as opposed to immediately visible, information does this representation contain? We use canonical color as a controlled test case to ask whether vision encoders make canonical-color information linearly accessible, even when color is removed from the input image. We construct a dataset of objects with canonical colors, and probe vision encoders for both color and object identity using color and grayscale images. We find that canonical color remains decodable from grayscale images, and is tied to predicted object identity, indicating a conceptual link. Extending this analysis to full VLMs, we find that VLM post-training can have a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder. Overall, canonical color provides a usefully controllable lens for tracing object-level conceptual semantic information in vision

translated_title: 规范颜色作为透视视觉编码器与视觉语言模型中概念可解码性的透镜
translated_abstract: 视觉编码器为视觉-语言模型构建图像输入的表示。这种表示中包含多少概念性信息（相对于直接可见的信息）？我们使用规范颜色作为一个受控测试案例，探究视觉编码器是否能将规范颜色信息线性可及，即使颜色已从输入图像中移除。我们构建了一个包含具有规范颜色物体的数据集，并使用彩色和灰度图像对视觉编码器中的颜色信息和物体身份信息进行探测。我们发现，规范颜色在灰度图像中仍然可解码，且与预测的物体身份相关联，表明二者之间存在概念性联系。将这一分析扩展到完整的视觉语言模型（VLM），我们发现VLM的后训练对视觉编码器中的颜色可解码性会产生惊人程度的影响。总体而言，规范颜色提供了一个有用且可控的透镜，用于追踪视觉表征中物体层面的概念语义信息。
tldr: 本文以规范颜色为受控探针，发现视觉编码器即使面对灰度图像也能线性解码规范颜色信息，且该信息与物体身份概念相关联，同时VLM后训练会对视觉编码器中的颜色可解码性产生显著影响。
en_tdlr: Using canonical color as a controlled probe, this paper reveals that vision encoders linearly encode canonical-color information even from grayscale images, conceptually linked to object identity, and that VLM post-training has a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder.
